POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Motor Vehicle batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle batteries.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle batteries.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

4. When learning Management of Road Transport, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Management of Road Transport.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Management of Road Transport.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Management of Road Transport.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Management of Road Transport.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

6. When learning electronic systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for electronic systems.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for electronic systems.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after electronic systems.
   D. Skip safety briefings for electronic systems.

7. When learning Assembly drawing and Sectioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.

8. When learning Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. When learning Electrical Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems.

11. When learning Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.

12. When learning Surface Development of pyramids, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Surface Development of pyramids.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Development of pyramids.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Development of pyramids.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Development of pyramids.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain electronic systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
